Q1.basis: the earlier SRP1 flexibility ladder put storage break-even between 1.5× and 1.75× (different model: legacy cohort, TV not in the objective) — low confidence. For reference, at 2× 12 of 18 had dF_exit < 0 (phase2x_ev_v3/phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q1)
Q1.decision_role: none (recorded only; same reasoning as 2x R1)
Q1.evaluated_as: phase_results.json prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_dF_exit_below_0 <= 9, over report.marginal_value_table.rows with source == "screen" (18 rows; dF_exit = F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0), x0 = this phase's x0 exit run, report.marginal_value_table.x0). A row without a numeric dF_exit (uncertified / harness_error) is not counted as dF_exit < 0; the number of such rows = prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_rows - prediction_inputs.Q1.screen_certified, reported beside
Q1.on_failure: recorded with the plans named; NON-STOPPING (same reasoning as 2x R1, TASKS 5a): no phase decision reads the sign of dF_exit -- the ladder, the table, the efficiency rule, the candidates and the pool read the exit class against x0 and settled values -- and its threshold (dF_exit < 0) lies inside the e_EV band (|dF_exit| <= e_EV = 17,494 EUR), so a failure is not a determinate sign result; the phase continues and the outcome is reported at the end
Q1.statement: at most 9 of the 18 screen plans have dF_exit < 0 against 1× x0

Q2.basis: 2x phase: Q2 held (P5_15_S56_PHASE2X_REPORT.md); its ESSO recovery events (6 on 4 plans, all tier 1) are reconciled by the extended solve-count guard of 4030508f, not failures

Q2.on_failure: a harness_error already stops the phase for review (exit 5, by construction); a local-solve failure is recorded with the run named (the run is then not certified / not settled and is listed as such, never "worse") (as at 2x)
Q2.statement: 0 harness_error and 0 local-solve failures over the phase

Q6.basis: author-approved efficiency rule with the measure of Planner decision P1 (TASKS 5a, 2026-11-24): > 1/2 of the screen and ladder rows NOT classed worse against x0 (confirm_candidate + unresolved: the rows the exit value cannot resolve) -> settled-direct; the v1 measure (+- e_EV band) recorded beside it, information only

Q7.basis: 2x: held on candidate 1 (the independent check; P5_15_S56_PHASE2X_REPORT.md). At 1x no exit view is served (D2), so the check guards the carry-over of e_EV and the exit/settled run identity (D1), not a served value
Q7.evaluated_as: AUTOMATIC: P.exit_view_check in phase_step at candidate_confirmation (fields read_cycle, F, bar; float.hex identity). phase_results.json report.candidates[i].exit_view_check (equal, differing, exit_run, exit_view, mode) and prediction_inputs.Q7 (n_checked, n_equal, termination_reason)
Q7.on_failure: the phase stops with exit 5, reason "exit_view_mismatch" (mode stop; a first-in-order harness_error stop precedes it, it precedes the offset stop). FALLBACK as at 2x (TASKS 5a, R4): a continuation spec of this root (--continuation-of, --no-pilot-exit-views: mode record, the check recorded, not stopping) and zero-solve reclassification; at 1x x0 already has its exit run and no exit view is served, so no extra exit run is needed; its freeze is a Planner decision
Q7.statement: as at 2×: for each candidate, the exit run's (read_cycle, F, bar) equals bitwise the exit_view of the candidate's settled summary
